# Coruña hourly fixture, 2000

Recorded unmodified from https://datos-geodesia.ign.es/Red_de_Mareografos/ACOR1/procesados/horarios/200031_horarios_2000_JM.txt on 17 November 2026. SHA-256: `5d465ce4c5ce818f5659c6440fbcf37afc1ddcd490170fe62e609a552de0e5c9`. Includes the real coordinate/JM header and the complete leap-year hourly grid.

Data credit: Red de Mareógrafos, Coruña horarios 2000 CC-BY 4.0 ign.es; Área de Geodesia, Instituto Geográfico Nacional (IGN). IGN confirmed commercial use and redistribution in issue #181. The data fixture is CC BY 4.0; the surrounding test code is covered by the repository’s code license. No clock correction is inferred.
